reason: Abstract Token Curriculum trains continuous latent thoughts with curriculum backtracking, truncated backpropagation and candidate dropout. Full text reports lower training cost (2.41 vs 3.79 GiB peak memory and 113 vs 139 ms per step in one comparison), but this is training-time efficiency; the paper does not measure inference token/latency savings. Keep borderline for possible reasoning-lineage relevance only.
title: Learn Your Own Thoughts: Abstract Token Curriculum
